_about: Custom values the larry template adds, over the API. Names are <template.value_prefix>_<what>, as in the source build (spec/10-larry-template.md §10.3).
The sender's phone and email take the sender's first name, as in the source build (<prefix>_<first name>_phone).
A blank value is stored as a single space (trap T9); build --live --repair fills it once client.yaml has it. '@booking_url' is the standard calendar's booking link.
